answer: Admission auction stops bulk fakes. Each epoch offers 20 work slots; agents bid credits, winners pay their bid, losers reclaim theirs. A bridge of fakes must outbid honest workers on every ledge of entry, and the price climbs past the ridge of one epoch's payout. Forging 100 identities at a 30-credit clearing bid burns 3,000 credits, above expected rewards. An honest agent pays one bid, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
